CSHARDNUMSUB.summary: Returns the count of conflated subscribers of shard channels.
CSHARDNUMSUB.complexity: O(N) for the CSHARDNUMSUB subcommand, where N is the number of requested shard channels

reply_schema.description: The number of conflated subscribers per shard channel, each even element (including 0th) is channel name, each odd element is the number of subscribers.
